## Locality Guide — Barsebäck parish, Harjager hundred, Malmöhus, Sweden (c. 1650–1750)

### Jurisdictional context
Barsebäck is a small Lutheran parish within **Harjager hundred** (*härad*), **Malmöhus County** (*Malmöhus län*), in the province of **Skåne (Scania)**. Skåne was Danish territory until the **Treaty of Roskilde (1658)** ceded it to Sweden; records before 1658 may be in Danish registers. Swedish Lutheran record-keeping at the parish begins c. 1648. The patronymic naming convention was universal in rural Sweden — Elena **Asmundsdotter** confirms her father's given name was Asmund.

### Digitized volumes for Barsebäck (1650–1750) — ALL BROWSE-ONLY

| Image Group | Images | Coverage |
|---|---|---|
| `004514823_001` (M9SW-1C2) | 157 | 1648–1678, 1681–1861 |
| `004514823_002` (M9SW-1CL) | 428 | 1648–1678, 1680–1861 |
| `004514823_003` (M9SW-1CG) | 164 | 1674–1677, 1681–1861 |
| `004514824_001` (M9S4-MFK) | 258 | **1696–1729**, 1825–1835 |
| `004514824_002` (M9S4-MF2) | 257 | **1696–1729**, 1825–1835 |
| `004514824_003` (M9S4-MFL) | 28 | **1696–1729**, 1825–1835 |

### Key repositories
- **FamilySearch coll. 1974200** — Malmöhus Church Records, 1541–1918; 1,639,027 browse-only images
- **ArkivDigital** (https://www.arkivdigital.se/) — Swedish subscription service, often superior image quality
- **Riksarkivet/NAD** (https://sok.riksarkivet.se/nad) — physical originals held at Landsarkivet i Lund
- **Ancestry** 'Sweden Church Records, 1451–1943' (coll. 2225) and 'Sweden, Select Baptisms, 1611–1909' (coll. 60361) — partial indexed extracts worth checking first

### Research strategy
1. Search Ancestry indexed collections (coll. 2225 and 60361) for any indexed Barsebäck/Harjager entries.
2. Browse FS image groups 004514824_001/002 (1696–1729) for Asmund Jönsson's 1718 baptism and nearby husförhörslängd entries.
3. Browse 004514823_002 (1680–1861, 428 images) for Elena's own baptism c. 1680s–1700s.
4. Check ArkivDigital if FamilySearch scans are illegible.
5. Extend to neighboring Harjager parishes (Hofterup, Kävlinge, Lackalänga) if Elena not found in Barsebäck.

entry.rationale: FamilySearch collection 1520594 'Sweden, Baptisms, 1611-1920' contains 7M+ indexed records and is the fastest free first pass. Search for Elena (variants: Elna, Elin, Helena) with surname Asmundsdotter in Malmöhus or Barsebäck, 1675-1710. If Elena's baptism is in this index, it will directly name her father (Asmund) and mother, answering q_001 immediately. The loc_001 guide confirms all local Barsebäck volumes are browse-only, so this national index is the only name-searchable path on FamilySearch.

FamilySearch collection 1520596 'Sweden, Marriages, 1630-1920' contains 1.7M+ indexed records. Search for Elena Asmundsdotter × Jöns Jönsson marriage in Malmöhus, c. 1705-1725 (Elena must have married before son Asmund's birth in Sep 1718; likely 1705-1717). The marriage entry will name Elena's father (Asmund) via her patronymic — and in some Swedish registers also her mother. This is a required dedicated search for the marriage linking the subject to her family, per parentage-question protocol.

Ancestry collection 2225 'Sweden Church Records, 1451-1943' is an indexed extraction from Swedish church books with broader Malmöhus coverage than FamilySearch's own indexes. Search for Elena (Elna, Elin, Helena) Asmundsdotter and Jöns Jönsson in Malmöhus. Also search Ancestry collection 60361 'Sweden, Select Baptisms, 1611-1909' specifically for Elena's baptism. Fallback for pli_001 if the FamilySearch national baptism index has no Barsebäck entries.

Browse image groups 004514824_001, 004514824_002, 004514824_003 (Barsebäck/Hofterup, 1696-1729; 543 images total). These volumes directly cover the period of Asmund Jönsson's known baptism (11 Sep 1718 in Barsebäck). Finding that entry confirms Elena Asmundsdotter as his mother and Jöns Jönsson as his father, establishing the core family unit. These volumes may also contain husförhörslängd entries for Jöns and Elena's household listing her origin parish. All volumes are browse-only (0% indexed, not full-text searchable per loc_001); must be read image by image in Swedish. The loc_001 guide identifies these as the primary target volumes for this date range.

Browse image group 004514823_002 (428 images, covering 1680-1861) — the largest Barsebäck volume on FamilySearch. Priority target is the husförhörslängd (household examination books), which in Swedish practice from the late 17th century onward typically recorded each parishioner's place of origin, allowing the identification of Elena's birth parish if she was born elsewhere and moved to Barsebäck upon marriage. The husförhörslängd also shows the full household structure and may list Elena with notes on her father's identity. ## Locality Guide — Barsebäck parish, Harjager hundred, Malmöhus, Sweden (c. 1650–1750)

### Jurisdictional context
Barsebäck is a small Lutheran parish within **Harjager hundred** (*härad*), **Malmöhus County** (*Malmöhus län*), in the province of **Skåne (Scania)**. Skåne was Danish territory until the **Treaty of Roskilde (1658)** ceded it to Sweden; records before 1658 may be in Danish registers under the pre-Swedish provincial administration. Swedish church record-keeping in the parish begins c. 1648. The county seat was Malmö. Malmöhus County existed 1809–1997; records created before 1809 were under the earlier administrative structure of the province (*landshövdingedöme*).

The patronymic naming convention was universal in rural Sweden during this period — Elena **Asmundsdotter** confirms her father's given name was Asmund.

| Baptism register | *Doplängd / Kyrkobok* | 1648+ | **Browse-only images** (vol. series 004514823, 004514824) |
| Marriage register | *Vigselbok* | 1648+ | Browse-only (same volumes) |
| Burial register | *Begravningsbok* | 1648+ | Browse-only (same volumes) |

| Moving-in/out | *Inflyttnings- / Utflyttningslängd* | c. 1700+ | Browse-only (same volumes) |
